translationRepairs: On guimao day of the third month the late Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Shenshen Xuanxian.
On guimao day of the third month the late Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Shengshen Xuanxian.
聖神 is Shengshen; Shenshen drops the final consonant in the first element of the posthumous title.
In the third month, on guimao day, conferred posthumous title on the late Empress Dowager as Empress Shenshen Xuanxian.
In the third month, on guimao day, conferred posthumous title on the late Empress Dowager as Empress Shengshen Xuanxian.
The literal field repeats the same misspelling of Shengshen and requires the same correction.

Prince of Chu Longyou was left to guard the capital; Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Xiao Paia was made supreme commander, and Northern Privy Chancellor Sengnu inspector general.

The Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou was left to guard the capital; Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Xiao Paia was made supreme commander, and Northern Privy Chancellor Sengnu inspector general.
皇弟 explicitly identifies Longyou as the emperor's younger brother and should not be omitted.
That year Gao Chengyan and two others passed the palace examination.
That year Gao Chengyan and one other, two men in all, passed the palace examination.
高承顏等二人 means Gao Chengyan and one other, two successful candidates in total.
That year, palace examination, released Gao Chengyan and two others passed and granted degree.
That year, at the palace examination, Gao Chengyan and one other—two men—were passed.
The literal field likewise mistakes a total of two for Gao Chengyan plus two more people.
On gengchen day Prince of Chu Longyou was made provisional Northern Privy Commissioner and Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
On gengchen day the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou was made provisional Northern Privy Commissioner and Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
皇弟 again explicitly marks Longyou as the emperor's younger brother.
On dinghai day Prince of Chu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi and left to guard the Eastern Capital.
On dinghai day the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi and left to guard the Eastern Capital.
The source again supplies the kinship term 皇弟, which the idiomatic field omitted.
On guiwei day Jurchen chieftains of the thirty divisions of Changbai Mountain came with tribute and asked for ranks and titles; their request was granted.
On guiwei day Jurchen chieftains of the thirty divisions of Changbai Mountain came with tribute and asked for ranks and titles.
乞授爵秩 records the chieftains' request for ranks and titles; it does not say that the request was granted.

The Ma clan was made Elegant Consort, the Geng clan Pure Consort, Palace Bed Attendant Bai Bright Consort, Palace Attire Attendant Li Gracious Consort, Palace Works Attendant Ai Fragrant Consort, and Palace Secretary Attendant Sun Harmonious Consort.

Lady Ma was made Elegant Consort, Lady Geng Pure Consort, Palace Bed Attendant Lady Bai Bright Consort, Palace Attire Attendant Lady Li Gracious Consort, Palace Works Attendant Lady Ai Fragrant Consort, and Palace Secretary Attendant Lady Sun Harmonious Consort.
Each 氏 identifies an individual woman by her clan name; the appointments apply to Lady Ma and the other women, not to their clans collectively.
